d:
When Bawri’s parents rent an apartment in Gokuldham Society and demand it be cleaned, they order "servant" Jethalal to sweep and mop the entire place. Jethalal is forced to do all the grueling housework while struggling to hide his true identity from passing society members.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
